Discharge.label: Discharge
Discharge.description: This LWM2M object provides water discharge events for a water tank monitoring device.

Discharge_Level.label: Discharge Level
Discharge_Level.description: The water level to discharge to in metres for a water level discharge event

Discharge_Date_Time_Storm.label: Discharge Date Time Storm
Discharge_Date_Time_Storm.description: The date time for which a water level discharge event should occur

Discharge_Volume.label: Discharge Volume
Discharge_Volume.description: The water volume to discharge in litres for a volume discharge event

Discharge_Date_Time_Volume.label: Discharge Date Time Volume
Discharge_Date_Time_Volume.description: The date time for which a volume discharge event should occur
